note: Held-out encode set. Never shown to designers. Spec-learners must write these in the language.

items.english: Stress reduces sleep, and less sleep increases stress. This vicious cycle keeps getting worse.
A bank account balance is a stock. Deposits flow in; withdrawals and fees flow out. Each month, interest is added in proportion to the balance.
facts: monthly interest inflow proportional to balance (reinforcing)

items.english: A message enters a queue. If the queue is full, the message is dropped. Otherwise, a worker picks it up, processes it, and writes the result to storage.
Prices rise when demand exceeds supply. Higher prices reduce demand and, after a delay, increase supply, pulling prices back toward equilibrium.
facts: prices are pulled back toward equilibrium (balancing)
